overview: 2026年，公司完成从 NEXG Berhad 更名为 Datasonic Group Berhad，并签订协议以合计约1512万令吉收购 IF Security Solution Sdn Bhd 与 Premiumway Development Sdn Bhd 全部股权；同时终止一项因消防认证条件未达成而未能完成的物业收购。政府就 Datasonic Technologies Sdn Bhd 提出约75亿令吉的潜在收购询价，公司确认收到政府要求提供指示性价格。与几内亚城市规建部的 MOA 年内多次更新，均无重大进展。
overview_en: In 2026, the company completed its name change from NEXG Berhad to Datasonic Group Berhad and entered into agreements to acquire the entire equity of IF Security Solution Sdn Bhd and Premiumway Development Sdn Bhd for a total consideration of approximately RM15.12 million; it also terminated a proposed property acquisition after a fire-safety condition precedent was not fulfilled.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 年内完成公司更名，并推进两项非关联方股权收购及一项物业收购终止。
segments.note_en: Completed a company name change during the year and progressed two non-related party share acquisitions and the termination of a property acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 AIMAX Berhad 及 AIMAX Assets Sdn Bhd 签订股份出售协议，分别以1,000,000令吉收购 IF Security Solution Sdn Bhd 全部股权、以14,124,994.14令吉收购 Premiumway Development Sdn Bhd 全部股权。
actions.text_en: Entered into share sale agreements with AIMAX Berhad and AIMAX Assets Sdn Bhd to acquire the entire equity of IF Security Solution Sdn Bhd for RM1,000,000 and Premiumway Development Sdn Bhd for RM14,124,994.14, respectively.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Datasonic Technologies Sdn Bhd 向 Pixio Sdn Bhd 发出终止通知，终止2025年7月10日的物业买卖协议，因未取得 BOMBA 消防证书/执照的先决条件。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Datasonic Technologies Sdn Bhd issued a notice of termination to Pixio Sdn Bhd to terminate the sale and purchase agreement dated 10 July 2025, as the condition precedent for obtaining a BOMBA fire certificate/licence was not fulfilled.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与几内亚共和国城市规建部 MOA 状态更新，截至公告日无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Status update on the MOA with the Ministry of Urban Planning, Housing and Territorial Development of the Republic of Guinea; no material development as at the announcement date.

actions.title: Govt exploring potential RM7.5b buyout of MyKad, passport supplier NexG's unit / NexG values Datasonic at RM7.5 bil, now that government loo
actions.text: 回应 Bursa 询问，确认政府要求就 Datasonic Technologies Sdn Bhd 的潜在收购提供指示性价格，媒体报道金额约75亿令吉。
actions.text_en: Responded to Bursa's query, confirming that the government requested an indicative price for the possible acquisition of Datasonic Technologies Sdn Bhd, with media reports citing about RM7.5 billion.
